hard_constraints: Use Star Wars Legends / Expanded Universe continuity; treat Disney-only material as invalid.
Set in 47 ABY post-Fate of the Jedi; preserve published continuity until AU divergences.

Force mechanics: active technique sensory vocabulary strictly 'a pulling, a suction, like standing next to a drain'; render body-experience before analysis; no stacking metaphors; no forbidden repeat phrases.
Torin's exchange: single short dialogue across distance; no speech; uses 'Ben' for affection; refusal warm, not cold.
Style: 'Jedi' singular/plural; 'Darth' capitalized before name; lowercase 'galaxy'; American English; no ABY/BBY in prose.
No clinical/scientific Force framing; experiential/mystical language.
No anachronistic terms: use Star Wars vocabulary (e.g., no 'radio', use 'comlink').
legends_continuity_notes: Ben Skywalker: Jedi Knight, son of Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker; post-Fate of the Jedi/Abeloth crisis; prior GAG service under Jacen Solo.
Ruusan Reformations (1000 BBY): Legends canon event recontextualized per AU as penance; Brotherhood of Darkness: Legends canon Sith faction led by Lord Kaan.
Force wounds precedents: Nathema (KOTOR/TOR), Malachor V (KOTOR II) – persistent phenomena with unreliable sense.
Vergences: Legends canon as Force concentrations (e.g., Valley of the Jedi).
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Veranthos valley approach; natural vergence turned wound site; Scar at floor (3m vertical distortion, heat-shimmer); three-way geometry: Veraine at Scar base, Torin on far ridgeline descending, resonance group (Ben/Sera/Kael) mid-valley, Desh to first amplification node.
Torin Hal: NSW Battle Master; used technique; warm paternal to Ben; corruption arc – affectionate refusal closes Ben/Torin dyad.
Active technique: Weave leans toward practitioner and dissolves; sharp boundary; practitioner as void/hungry in Force perception.
Ben's POV: registers technique somatically before analysis; desperate hope -> grief -> activation focus.
No interior narration of final Torin acceptance; action drives: call, response, activation, group moves.
Warmth load-bearing: Torin's 'Ben' and posture register certainty via affection.
allowed_au_divergences: Battle of Veranthos, forbidden technique (Gavran's unweaving), wound/Scar at Veranthos vergence.
Survivors as anchors: Torin Hal (Jedi), Sera Varik (Jedi), Kael Drenn (Sith conscript).
Seal infrastructure: anchor nodes, Ruusan Corridor, amplification array (Veraine's repurposing).
Ankhural Codex heresy; technique lineage (Nathema -> Malachor -> etc.).
